title: Monaghan Medical: Monaghan Medical ISO 14001 Certification and Stated Objectives
summary: Monaghan Medical says its environmental-management system attained ISO 14001 certification and carries continual-improvement, waste-diversion, and emissions objectives. Entity test: The bounded record can publish as a denominator warning, but it does not test persistence of the reported line-output change.
key_findings: The control record remains current enough to test whether quantified surveillance or environmental outcomes are publicly exposed; they are not supplied on the page.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests management-system, equipment, layout, quality-control, and supply-condition alternatives.
Compatibility: Same manufacturer; product-event counts and environmental management controls do not identify the MEP production line or units distributed.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: Certification and stated objectives do not establish line output, yield, scrap, downtime, delivery, waste, emissions, or causal effect.
The event count is independently accessible; defect rate, line identity, and causal interpretation are not validated.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
